territorial_scope.description: Directs U.S. Commerce Department rulemaking on controlled exports to Israel; no non-U.S. actors are named.

summary.short: Directs the Secretary of Commerce, when finalizing the 'Framework for Artificial Intelligence Diffusion' interim rule, to add Israel to the country list in Supplement No. 5 to part 740 of the CFR and apply the same export requirements and exceptions to Israel as to listed countries.
summary.long: H.R. 3303, the America–Israel AI Cooperation Act, was introduced in the House on May 8, 2025 and referred to the Committee on Foreign Affairs. Its operative section, Sec. 2, applies notwithstanding any other provision of law. When finalizing the interim rule 'Framework for Artificial Intelligence Diffusion' (90 Fed. Reg. 4544), the Secretary of Commerce, acting through the Undersecretary of Commerce for Industry and Security, must modify the rule. The modification must include Israel in the list of countries in the amendment to Supplement No. 5 to part 740 of title 15, Code of Federal Regulations. It must also ensure that exports to Israel of items controlled under that rule are subject to the same requirements and exceptions as exports to other listed countries. The bill states no penalties, thresholds or separate effective date. Its practical content depends on the terms of the final rule.

relations.target_text: Framework for Artificial Intelligence Diffusion (90 Fed. Reg. 4544), interim rule
relations.note: Section 2 directs the Secretary of Commerce, when finalizing this interim rule, to modify it to include Israel and to apply the same requirements and exceptions as the other listed countries. The bill does not amend the rule's text directly.

evidence.quote: in finalizing the interim rule titled ``Framework for Artificial Intelligence Diffusion'' (90 Fed. Reg. 4544)

relations.target_text: Supplement No. 5 to part 740 of title 15, Code of Federal Regulations
relations.note: Section 2(1) refers to the country list in Supplement No. 5 to 15 CFR part 740, as amended by the interim rule, and directs that Israel be included in it.

notes: Bill as introduced 8 May 2025 and referred to the Committee on Foreign Affairs; registry status is pending. The title refers to an exception to export license requirements, but the operative text (Sec. 2) directs modification of the interim rule to include Israel and apply the same requirements and exceptions as other listed countries; it does not itself state an exception. Sec. 2 opens with 'Notwithstanding any other provision of law' and sets no deadline or effective date. The rule and CFR references are recorded as written and are not resolved to registry entries.

thresholds.note: The bill text contains no numeric cutoff at which legal treatment changes. Its only numbers are the citation 90 Fed. Reg. 4544, the reference to Supplement No. 5 to part 740 of title 15 CFR, and section numbers. The thresholds, if any, in the interim rule 'Framework for Artificial Intelligence Diffusion' that Sec. 2 directs the Secretary to modify are not in the document and were not coded.
